issuer: the Bureau of Motor Vehicles of the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (Department of Public Safety)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Commonwealth Code as the CNMI Law Revision Commission publishes it section by section (cnmilaw.gov, reached through www.cnmilaw.org's redirect), Title 9 (Vehicle Code), Division 2. 9 CMC § 2205: class 2 covers all two-axle motor vehicles; no operator's license or learner's permit of classes 1 to 3 is issued before the applicant has attained sixteen years. § 2202(c), as repealed and reenacted by PL 20-90 (18 February 2019): a fee of $50 for each operator's license issued (a veteran pays 25% less, § 2202(d), not held). § 2208: the Bureau of Motor Vehicles issues driver's licenses and identification cards. § 2209(b)(1): a non-temporary card (license or identification card) expires on the holder's birth date in the third year following its issue, held as 3 years (a reading: the term runs to a birthday, so a little over or under three years). A temporary license for someone in the United States on a time-limited status lasts their authorised stay or one year (§ 2209(c)(3)), not held. The identification card is held with its fee null (left to the Bureau's regulations, § 2209(b)(6), not read) and the same expiry; the Code sets no age for it. The Code's dollar is the US dollar.

sources.title: 9 CMC § 2202, Operator’s License: Fees
sources.said: A fee of $50 shall be paid for each operator’s license issued, with the exception of an operator’s license issued to a Veteran as provided in subsection (d). ... repealed and reenacted by PL 20-90, §3 (Feb. 18, 2019)

sources.title: 9 CMC § 2205, Classes of License; Age Requirements
sources.said: (2) All two-axle motor vehicles. ... Sixteen years, in the case of an operator’s license or learner’s permit issued under subsections (a)(1), (a)(2) or (a)(3) of this section;

sources.title: 9 CMC § 2208, Issuance of Licenses and Identification Cards
sources.said: The Bureau of Motor Vehicles shall issue a driver’s license, temporary driver’s license, identification card, or temporary identification card to a qualified applicant

sources.title: 9 CMC § 2209, Expiration and Renewal of License or Identification Card
sources.said: A non-temporary card shall expire on the holder’s birth date in the third year following the issuance of the card. ... The Bureau of Motor Vehicles is authorized to promulgate regulations to determine the appropriate fee for any person applying for an identification card.
